About Us

We turn your
vision into reality

Create & Fabricate LLC is a full-service fabrication company specializing in custom vinyl production, backdrops, bars, décor, and signage. With our in-house manufacturing capabilities, we provide high-quality, tailored solutions that bring your creative vision to life.

"By choosing us, you not only get a product, but an experience that will make your event stand out. You bring the ideas, and we bring them to life."

How We Work

From Concept to Reality

I
Consultation

We listen to your vision, understanding your brand, timeline, and budget before anything else.

II
Design & Mockup

Our team creates detailed renderings and mockups so you can visualize the final product.

III
Fabrication

All production happens in-house with rigorous quality control at every stage.

IV
Installation

Professional installation ensuring seamless setup and a flawless final presentation.
